steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each contract is placed by its last review and whether its liability and termination terms are standard.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 high-risk contract has not been reviewed in 12 months

findings.title: High-value, high-risk contract with no review in 12 months
findings.fix: Review the contract and decide whether to reopen

outcome.notChecked: Commercial value beyond the register; legal interpretation of terms, which counsel confirms.
